title: Jesus... I'm Down To Three-Word Prayers. 🙏
topic: his words ran out months ago and the only prayer he can still say is the Bible's last, three words long

bible.text: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I'm down to three-word prayers. 🙏

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Long ones feel fake now. I just say, come.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're in good company. 'Even so, come' is the Bible's last prayer.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Is it enough? It feels too small to matter.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I said it first. Surely I come quickly. Your words agree with Mine.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Short prayers still cross the distance. Keep saying it.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone whose prayers got shorter. 🙏
